claim: On May 11, 2023 ElastiCache for Redis OSS gained support for modifying cluster mode: you can migrate clusters from Cluster Mode Disabled (CMD) to Cluster Mode Enabled (CME).
question: When could ElastiCache clusters first be migrated from cluster mode disabled to cluster mode enabled?

values.display: from Cluster Mode Disabled (CMD) to Cluster Mode Enabled (CME)
values.spoken: from cluster mode disabled to cluster mode enabled

note: Current truth is in the modify-cluster-mode page: the change is one way only, disabled to enabled.
